name: Spot SaaS

sources.title: Spotsaas - Get Your Software Listed (criteria, process, free to list)
Spotsaas - claim your free profile (linked from get-listed page)

requirements: B2B ONLY: 'Genuine B2B use case - consumer apps, internal tools, and white-label reskins are not eligible'
Active commercial product: 'live, maintained, and available for purchase or trial' - no abandoned projects or vaporware
Verified company behind it: real website, real contact information, accountable owner - 'we verify before we list'
Unique original product (no duplicates or near-identical forks); accurate complete info (features, pricing structure, category fit); must fit one of their 419 defined categories
Free to list, no credit card required; manual review of every submission
preparation: Product name, category, and a brief description (application takes ~5 minutes per the site)
Company verification details: real website, contact information, accountable owner
Honest pricing structure and feature list - 'misleading or incomplete submissions are rejected'
workflow: Open https://www.spotsaas.com/get-listed and click 'Apply to get listed' (goes to partners.spotsaas.com/listing/new)
Fill the application form: product name, category, brief description
Wait for manual review - 'new listings are reviewed within 2 weeks - usually faster'
Once approved the listing goes live across Spotsaas (buyer discovery, AI-search indexing, review collection)
Optional afterwards: 'claim your free profile' for buyer-intent features; growth/managed plans are a separate paid track
watchFor: This is a curated marketplace, not an aggregator - ineligible products (consumer/internal/white-label) are rejected outright
Review takes up to 2 weeks; there is no instant path advertised for the basic listing
A 'Book a strategy call' (Calendly) CTA and managed growth plans exist - optional upsell, not required for listing
Phone number and US address are published on the site if you need to chase a review
countsAsLive: The product has a public listing page on spotsaas.com, appears in its software category, and is open to verified reviews
unknowns: Exact fields inside the partner-portal application (partners.spotsaas.com is a separate app)
Whether an account is required for the application itself
Whether listing outbound links are dofollow
